steps: Pick the course you want to study, such as B.Tech, MBA, MBBS, Design or Law.
Choose the institutions and programs you want to apply to.
Share your details one time in the common application. No separate form for every college.
A Career Mantra counsellor contacts you and helps you with the next steps.
Finish the admission formalities with the college you choose.
faqs: What is the Common Application Process?

It is a standardized form that lets you apply to multiple institutions, programs or services with a single application. It removes the need to fill out a separate form for every college or university.
Do I have to fill a separate form for each college?
No. You fill the common application once and can choose more than one college.
Which courses can I apply for?
You can start with B.Tech, MBA, MBBS, Design or Law. Counsellors can also guide you on other programs.
A Career Mantra counsellor contacts you on the mobile number you share and guides you through the next steps.
Can I apply to more than one college?
Yes. That is the idea of a common application. Select all the colleges you are interested in.
